summary: Tested the BULKAPI integration end to end (backend and frontend). Covered: config read from API_TOKEN/API_SECRET/API_BASE_URL with fallback to the BULKAPI_* names; the new live_providers module (seeding, CRUD, role checks, a test must pass before a provider can go live, failed test turns the provider off, player list filtered by enabled providers, launch blocked for disabled providers); GET /api/admin/live/server-ip; launch URL AES-256-ECB payload, decrypted and checked against the query; callbacks; and the Admin Live Casino UI (Whitelist card, Providers tab add/delete, staff read-only view, player empty state). The new code works as designed. Preview cannot actually launch games: API_BASE_URL=https://bulkapi.org has no DNS, the env token is a URL ending in .php, and the secret is 30 characters instead of 32. 4 older regression tests are now out of date because of the new provider gating.

minor.issue: API_BASE_URL/BULKAPI_BASE_URL=https://bulkapi.org does not resolve (curl exit 6, getent finds nothing), while bulkapi.site resolves and /launch_game returns 301. As a result status.reachable=false, every provider test fails with 'Could not reach BULKAPI: ConnectError', and no provider can ever be turned on. Process env has no API_TOKEN/API_SECRET; the BULKAPI_API_TOKEN fallback is a 35-char URL ending '.php', and BULKAPI_SECRET_KEY is 30 bytes. These are config/user-side problems, not code bugs.

PUT /admin/live/credentials rejects tokens that look like URLs, but the env fallback is never checked the same way. Status shows 'API token saved' with a green check while the token is a URL. Show the same warning for env tokens.

Any failed probe sets enabled=false, including network blips like a timeout or DNS failure. In production one flaky admin test hides a live provider from every player. Consider only auto-disabling when BULKAPI gives a real error reply (status != 0).
The 6 default providers are re-created on every startup, so an admin who deletes Evolution/Pragmatic etc. sees them come back after a restart or deploy.

The count only includes active games, but DELETE refuses if any non-deleted game exists (including inactive ones). The UI shows the trash icon when games=0 (only inactive games) and the delete then fails with a 400. Same mismatch for the Test button: it is disabled when there are 0 active games, but the backend would probe an inactive game.

The domain 'scarmenta.com' is hard-coded; it should come from env (FRONTEND_URL). The IP really does change: preview returned 35.225.230.28 now, while PRD notes 34.170.12.145. This confirms the warning on the card.

Import silently creates providers (disabled) for any new vendor name, e.g. 'Other'. The old regression test test_live_credentials_import does not clean these up; I removed the 3 leftovers (Other, Playtech, Iconic21) from my run.

issues: The Test button is disabled for providers with 0 games, but nothing explains why; add a tooltip like 'Add a game first'.
The trash icon on seeded default providers is misleading, because they come back on restart.

action_items: Update the outdated regression tests in tests/test_live_casino_bulkapi.py (test_launch_url, test_launch_zero_balance, test_player_games_hide_uid, test_reports). They assume 'Evolution' is enabled, but providers now start disabled and can only be enabled after a successful probe. Have the fixtures create a TEST_ provider and enable it in mongo, as test_live_providers_central.py does.

Fix test isolation: test_live_credentials_import deletes bulkapi_creds directly in mongo, so the backend keeps the old token in its 30s _CACHE. Running both files in parallel (xdist) makes the callback tests fail with 'invalid token'. Clear credentials through DELETE /api/admin/live/credentials (which resets the cache) or run these files with -n 0. The test should also clean up providers created by import.
Validate env token/secret in /admin/live/status: warn when the token looks like a URL or the secret is not 32 bytes.
Do not auto-disable a provider when the probe fails with a network error (status 0).
Respect admin deletions of default providers (e.g. a 'seeded' flag or soft-delete) instead of re-seeding on every startup.
Make the provider 'games' count match the delete/test rules (count non-deleted games).
User/config: set API_BASE_URL to a host that resolves (bulkapi.site resolves; bulkapi.org does not), and set real API_TOKEN/API_SECRET (32 chars).
critical_code_review_comments: bulkapi.py is 570 lines and growing (catalogue, launch, callback, admin reports, credentials, import). Consider splitting out the import and the reports.
LAUNCH_URL is computed at import time, so changing API_BASE_URL needs a backend restart. Fine, but worth documenting.
_CACHE is per process; with more than one uvicorn worker, saved credentials take up to 30s to reach the other workers.
Callback credits rounds even when the game's provider is disabled. This is correct for settlement and worth keeping.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the new test_live_providers_central.py (13/13); older test_live_casino_bulkapi.py 12/16, where all 4 failures are outdated tests (provider gating), not regressions

seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ providers and games were created and then deleted. I removed 3 providers auto-created by the old import regression test in this run (Other, Playtech, Iconic21, created_by admin at 08:29). The demo balance is unchanged at 1039.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the live casino test files with -n 0 (serial). Export backend/.env (set -a; . ./.env) and set BULK_TOKEN=$BULKAPI_API_TOKEN before running pytest. All providers start disabled; the probe cannot pass in preview (bulkapi.org has no DNS), so tests must enable TEST_ providers directly in mongo.
